explication: AAPS is an Android automated insulin-delivery application. Its principal workflow is to receive glucose and therapy state, calculate an APS recommendation, and communicate insulin actions to a pump while exposing status, history, alarms, and watch data. The tree shows the contracts and several pump integrations, but not the central loop implementation or most concrete plugins, so those relationships are represented conservatively. Sampled code directly supports pump event dispatch, Insight service binding, cloud-provider selection, Nightscout authentication, and watch freshness handling.
